title: Vision Plan Copays and Frame Allowances — Northgate Optical
content:
Northgate Optical bills four vision insurance plans on every lens design: VSP, EyeMed, Davis Vision and Superior Vision. Under each plan the member pays a lens copay for the design, and the plan covers the frame up to its frame allowance.

## Lens copay by design and plan (USD)

| Lens design | VSP | EyeMed | Davis Vision | Superior Vision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses | 25.00 | 25.00 | 20.00 | 25.00 |
| Northgate Lined Bifocal Lenses | 40.00 | 40.00 | 35.00 | 40.00 |
| Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses | 50.00 | 50.00 | 45.00 | 50.00 |
| Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses | 55.00 | 65.00 | 50.00 | 60.00 |
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses | 95.00 | 110.00 | 90.00 | 100.00 |
| Northgate Digital Freeform Progressive Lenses | 135.00 | 150.00 | 125.00 | 140.00 |

## Frame allowance by plan (USD), identical on every design

| Plan | Frame allowance |
|---|---|
| VSP | 130.00 |
| EyeMed | 120.00 |
| Davis Vision | 100.00 |
| Superior Vision | 100.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The lens copay is what the member pays for the design under the plan; the plan covers the rest of the base lens charge.
- The frame allowance is how much of the frame charge the plan covers.
- A plan that is not one of the four listed is not billed by Northgate Optical.

Example lookups: Northgate Standard Progressive Lenses under EyeMed carry a 65.00 copay and a 120.00 frame allowance; Northgate Lined Trifocal Lenses under Davis Vision carry a 45.00 copay and a 100.00 frame allowance.
